{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check for sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline
severe_with_sentinel = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]

# Count how many severe patients have sentinel values
print("Number of SEVERE patients with -999 in biomarker_baseline:", len(severe_with_sentinel))

# Filter out sentinel values for the mean calculation
severe_without_sentinel = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL)
mean_baseline_severe = severe_without_sentinel['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) among SEVERE patients (excluding -999): {mean_baseline_severe}")"}
